steps.title: Configure Build Environment and Dependencies
steps.description: Configured Temurin 17, Gradle 8.5, Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2, compileSdkVersion 34, targetSdkVersion 34, and Java 8 source compatibility.

steps.title: Set Up Application Metadata and Package Identifier
steps.description: Defined package name com.boxstockmanager.app and app_name Box Stock Manager in app-meta.json.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest and System Permissions
steps.description: Configured permissions for Camera, Vibrator, and Storage along with standard Material theme activity registration.

steps.title: Initialize Offline SQLite Database Helper and Schema
steps.description: Created DatabaseHelper class for persistent local storage of inventory items, product details, categories, and stock transactions.

steps.title: Define Data Models for Inventory and Movement History
steps.description: Implemented Product, BoxItem, StockTransaction, and ProductScannerResult object models.

steps.title: Build Camera and Gallery OCR Code Scanning Processing Helper
steps.description: Implemented OcrScannerHelper combining ZXing multi-format decoding with image preprocessing and Tesseract OCR parsing.

steps.title: Design Main Layout and Navigation Interfaces
steps.description: Created activity_main.xml layout containing bottom navigation bar, dashboard view, search filters, and transaction history tabs.

steps.title: Design Custom Dialogs for Product Entry and Detail View
steps.description: Created XML layouts for product addition/editing form dialogs and detailed product overview display.

steps.title: Design Full-Screen Live Camera Overlay Interface
steps.description: Built dialog_scanner.xml providing a full-screen camera view finder with flashlight toggle and close controls.

steps.title: Implement Custom ListView Row Items
steps.description: Created XML layout files for product rows, transaction rows, and legacy box stock items.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Business Logic and Controllers
steps.description: Connected camera preview callbacks, stock increment/decrement operations, gallery image picker, dynamic calculation counters, and UI adapters.

steps.title: Building Box Stock Manager
steps.description: Compiling and assembling final debug APK for Box Stock Manager using Gradle build system.
